_about: Public-domain John Prentiss Kewley Henshaw (1792-1852), rector of St Peter's, Baltimore, and Episcopal Bishop of Rhode Island, for the Word Hoard: The Communicant's Guide, An Inquiry into the Prophecies of the Second Advent, the Memoir of Bishop Richard Channing Moore, and a funeral sermon. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 98 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

henshaw-communicants-guide: The communicant's guide, or, An introduction to the sacrament of the Lord's Supper (Baltimore : J.N. Toy and W.R. Lucas, 1831)
henshaw-second-advent: An inquiry into the meaning of the prophecies relating to the second advent of our Lord Jesus Christ (Baltimore : Daniel Brunner, 1842)
henshaw-memoir-moore: Memoir of the life of the Rt. Rev. Richard Channing Moore, D. D., Bishop of the Protestant Episcopal Church in the Diocese of Virginia (Philadelphia, W. Stavely, 1842)
